hubs.description: The company-wide party register: the umbrella concept covering every customer, vendor and employee, identified by a single business entity number that is unique across all parties and used as the integration key into sales, purchasing and HR.
hubs.name: hub_business_entity

hubs.description: An employee of the business, uniquely and consistently identified by their national identification number, the strongest natural business identifier for a person in the HR domain.
hubs.name: hub_employee

hubs.description: A reseller store identified by its business entity reference. Keyed differently from the enterprise hub_business_entity and modelled as its own hub per ratified human decision (REQ-009).
hubs.name: hub_store

hubs.description: A sales representative identified by their business entity reference, which is also their employee reference. Keyed differently from the enterprise hub_business_entity and modelled as its own hub per ratified human decision (REQ-056).
hubs.name: hub_sales_person

links.description: The sales representative assigned to serve each reseller store; a store is served by exactly one representative who may serve many stores (REQ-010, REQ-113). The representative participation is read from a relation carrying hub_sales_person's own key; aliasing of Store's foreign key is decided at the link checkpoint.
links.name: link_store_sales_person

links.description: Declared foreign key Store.SalesPersonID references NATIONALIDNUMBER; ratified from the source catalogue (WP34).
links.name: link_store_employee

satellites.description: The current remuneration terms for a representative: current quota figure, bonus and commission percentage; access-restricted remuneration data (REQ-058, REQ-059, REQ-060, REQ-126, REQ-158).
satellites.name: sat_sales_person_remuneration
satellites.split_rationale: Split by data classification (access-restricted remuneration) from operational running totals.

satellites.description: The operationally maintained running sales totals (year-to-date and previous year) for a representative, retained for reconciliation (REQ-061, REQ-062, REQ-064, REQ-154).
satellites.name: sat_sales_person_running_totals
satellites.split_rationale: Operational running totals separated from remuneration terms by sensitivity and rate of change.

satellites.description: The full history of sales quotas per representative, each row the quota amount in force from a quota date (REQ-123, REQ-124, REQ-125).
satellites.name: sat_sales_person_quota_history
satellites.split_rationale: Dated quota history at finer grain than the representative, with several rows valid over time distinguished by quota date.
